description: Downgrade enforcement (soft lock invites), standardized profile editing for players & bookies, and Picks tab filter bar redesign with member dropdown + bet type chips.

userStories.title: Fix bookie profile status to check tier OR subscription
userStories.description: As a bookie with Pro tier, I want to see 'Pro' on my profile status even if I got Pro through a direct DB grant.
acceptanceCriteria: In ProfileSettingsView, status row checks both `bookie.tier` and `bookie.subscriptionStatus`
Display 'Pro' with Theme.accent color if `tier == .pro` OR `subscriptionStatus` is `.active` or `.pro`
Display 'Free' with Theme.textSecondary only if both tier is free AND subscriptionStatus is not active/pro
Update `BookieTier.isPro` computed property to also accept when subscriptionStatus is .active or .pro (or create a new `Bookie.isPro` computed property that checks both)
All views that check isPro use this unified logic
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: ProfileSettingsView is in SettingsView.swift around line 392. It currently shows `bookie.subscriptionStatus.rawValue.capitalized`. The Bookie model is in Booki/Models/Bookie.swift. BookieTier.isPro is currently `switch self { case .pro, .chart: return true }`. A Bookie-level computed property `var isPro: Bool { tier.isPro || subscriptionStatus == .active || subscriptionStatus == .pro }` would be cleanest. Then update all `bookies.first?.tier.isPro` references to use `bookies.first?.isPro`.

userStories.title: Add bet type filter chips to Picks tab
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want to filter picks by Singles, Multi-Pick, or Futures to quickly find specific bet types.
acceptanceCriteria: Add three filter chips next to the member dropdown: Singles, Multi-Pick, Futures
Chips are horizontally scrollable in the same row as the member dropdown
Singles filters to single bets (not parlays, not futures/outrights)
Multi-Pick filters to parlay/multi-pick tickets only
Futures filters to outright/futures bets only
Chips are mutually exclusive — tapping an active chip deselects it (shows all types)
Active chip uses Theme.accent background with Theme.background text, inactive uses Theme.cardBackground with Theme.textSecondary text
Bet type filter is additive with member dropdown — e.g., 'Tyler' + 'Multi-Pick' = Tyler's multi-picks
Filters apply on top of Open/Past segmented picker
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Add to BetsListView.swift alongside the member dropdown from US-008. Determine bet type from the Bet model — check for parlay/ticket associations, market type for futures/outrights. The filter state can be an optional enum: `@State private var selectedBetType: BetTypeFilter?` with cases .singles, .multiPick, .futures.
